# Morocco Quest

> Morocco Quest is a licensed Moroccan travel agency based in Marrakech. We offer private Morocco tours, Sahara desert tours, small group tours, luxury desert camps, and tailor-made multi-day tour packages operated by expert local guides.

Morocco Quest (also known as Morocco Quest DMC) is based in Marrakech, Morocco. We operate in English, French, and Spanish and specialise in private Sahara desert tours, Marrakech-to-Merzouga journeys, Atlas Mountains trekking, Fes cultural tours, luxury riad stays, camel trekking, and Aït Benhaddou visits. All tours are led by licensed local guides. Contact us at +212-654-069-718.

## Top Tours

- [5-Day Marrakech Luxury City Break](https://morocco-quest.com/tours/5-day-marrakech-luxury-city-break-gardens-culture-relaxation): Gardens, culture and relaxation — 5 days from Marrakech
- [5-Day Marrakech & Sahara Desert Tour](https://morocco-quest.com/tours/5-day-marrakech-sahara-luxury-desert-discovery-adventure-tour): Luxury desert discovery — camel trekking, dunes, desert camp
- [8-Day Morocco Luxury Cultural Discovery](https://morocco-quest.com/tours/8-day-morocco-luxury-cultural-discovery-art-heritage-culinary-delights): Art, heritage & culinary highlights across Morocco
- [Royal Cities of Morocco 6-Day Tour](https://morocco-quest.com/tours/royal-cities-of-morocco-6-day-luxury-imperial-cultural-tour): Imperial cultural tour — Fes, Meknes, Rabat, Casablanca
- [9-Day Andalusian Morocco Rail Tour](https://morocco-quest.com/tours/9-day-andalusian-morocco-train-tour): From Tangier to Marrakech by train — heritage and coast

## Top Activities

- [Hot Air Balloon Ride over Marrakech](https://morocco-quest.com/activities/magical-hot-air-balloon-ride-over-marrakech-with-berber-breakfast): Sunrise flight with Berber breakfast
- [Moroccan Cooking Class in Marrakech](https://morocco-quest.com/activities/authentic-3-hour-moroccan-cooking-class-in-marrakech-morning-afternoon-sessions): 3-hour hands-on tagine and couscous class
- [Marrakech Medina Hidden Gems Tour](https://morocco-quest.com/activities/marrakech-medina-hidden-gems-tour-discover-authentic-local-life-with-a-private-guide): Private guided tour of souks and local life
- [Essaouira Day Trip from Marrakech](https://morocco-quest.com/activities/essaouira-day-trip-from-marrakech-private-atlantic-coast-experience): Atlantic coast, ramparts, and argan oil workshops
- [High Atlas Day Hike & Berber Hospitality](https://morocco-quest.com/activities/a-day-in-the-high-atlas-hike-tea-ritual-berber-hospitality): Trek to Berber villages with traditional tea ritual
